title: SEVENTEEN’s Seungkwan and Dino bid emotional farewell as military duty begins
summary: K-pop group SEVENTEEN members Seungkwan and Dino officially entered military service on Oct. 26, leaving fans with emotional farewell messages and shared photos before starting their active-duty…

blocks.text: K-pop group SEVENTEEN members Seungkwan and Dino officially entered military service on Oct. 26, leaving fans with emotional farewell messages and shared photos before starting their active-duty service. Both vocalists will fulfill their mandatory duty within the South Korean Army military band. Their entry marks the final wave of enlistments for the 13-member group to complete their military hiatus. READ: Seventeen says goodbye for now, promises return within 3 years Hours before entering the recruit training center, Seungkwan and Dino connected with their fanbase, CARAT, through social media.
